title: Applied AI Engineer, Voice AI & Agentic CX
description:
**Company Description:**
AHACX is a customer experience company combining human expertise, AI and enterprise technology to run and continuously improve customer operations.

We're looking for an exceptional, hands-on AI engineer with a passion for building and deploying production-grade Voice AI and agentic solutions..

**Role Description**
The Applied AI Engineer, Voice AI & Agentic CX is a Remote role. This role designs, develops, and deploys Voice AI and agentic customer experience solutions, focusing on real-time interactions, call routing, and conversational intelligence across contact centers. This is a founding team role, to design and shape the future. We value builders who ship. Strong engineering fundamentals, independent problem-solving and demonstrated production experience matter more than titles or years of experience.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Computer Science and Software Development, with experience building production-grade systems and APIs.
* Applied expertise in Neural Networks and Pattern Recognition for real-world CX, speech, or conversational applications.
* Hands-on experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), including intent detection, entity extraction, dialogue management, and language model integration.
* Proficiency in modern programming languages (such as Python, Java, or C++), ML frameworks (such as PyTorch or TensorFlow), and cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with Voice AI technologies (speech recognition, text-to-speech, telephony platforms) and integration into contact center or enterprise environments.
* Intelligent agent handoffs, context continuity and conversational workflows.
* LLMs, orchestration, tool calling and enterprise integrations.
* Monitoring, tracing, evaluations and production reliability.
* Ability to analyze customer interaction data, design experiments, and interpret model performance metrics to drive iterative improvements.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and translate complex technical concepts into clear CX outcomes.

**Compensation:**
Base salary with potential future equity participation, depending on experience and mutual fit.

**Apply**

Share your résumé and, ideally, an example of a Voice AI or agentic application you've personally built and deployed.

**AHACX | Run CX. Reinvent CX.**

description:

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Integration, Officer
description:

This platform reflects State Street’s years of experience servicing complex instruments for our global client base and our investments in building advanced data management technologies. * Git code versioning and merging, release and feature branches.

**Qualifications**

* B.S. degree (or foreign education equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, and Physics or other technical course of study required. MS degree strongly preferred.

**Experience**

* A minimum of 10 years of experience in data integration/orchestration services
* Strong Data warehousing Concepts, ETL tools such as Talend Cloud Data Integration tool
* Strong SQL knowledge and debugging skills is a must
* Experience in service architecture and providing data driven solutions for client requirements
